steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "cat > /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints.gpx <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>
<gpx version=\"1.1\" creator=\"OsmAnd\" xmlns=\"http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1\">
  <metadata>
    <name>Liechtenstein waypoints</name>
  </metadata>
  <wpt lat=\"47.1569\" lon=\"9.5466\"><name>Oberplanken, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat=\"47.2608\" lon=\"9.5609\"><name>Schaanwald, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat=\"47.0667\" lon=\"9.5025\"><name>Balzers, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat=\"47.2096\" lon=\"9.5442\"><name>Nendeln, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <rte>
    <name>Liechtenstein waypoints route</name>
    <rtept lat=\"47.1569\" lon=\"9.5466\"><name>Oberplanken, Liechtenstein</name></rtept>
    <rtept lat=\"47.2608\" lon=\"9.5609\"><name>Schaanwald, Liechtenstein</name></rtept>
    <rtept lat=\"47.0667\" lon=\"9.5025\"><name>Balzers, Liechtenstein</name></rtept>
    <rtept lat=\"47.2096\" lon=\"9.5442\"><name>Nendeln, Liechtenstein</name></rtept>
  </rte>
</gpx>
EOF
am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d file:///sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints.gpx >/dev/null
ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints.gpx
grep -n '<name>' /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints.gpx
am force-stop net.osmand"
